meta.requirement: Explore Windrise (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Elemental Powers
start.text:
''A flash of orange somewhere above you. A zip line deploys with a sharp crack and a girl in a red scarf drops out of the sky, landing in a neat crouch a few paces away. She stands up, dusts off her gloves, and turns to face you with a wide grin like she does this every day.''

Amber: Oh! Didn't expect to run into anyone out here. ''She adjusts her bow strap.'' I'm Amber! Outrider of the Knights of Favonius. You new to the region?

choices.label: Passing through. Nice landing, by the way

No_What_is_it_exactly.text: Amber: ''steps aside proudly'' That is a Statue of Seven! This one was built in honor of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon. God of wind, freedom, all that wonderful stuff. ''She presses her fists to her hips.'' Here's the cool part though: travelers who pray here can actually receive a blessing from the statue. A little piece of Anemo power flows into you, and after that your attacks carry the wind. Pretty amazing, right?

Just_arrived_actually.text: Amber: ''beams'' A traveller! Perfect timing. I was just finishing my patrol. ''She tilts her head, following your gaze to the enormous stone statue looming behind her.'' Oh! You noticed the Statue of Seven. Have you ever seen one up close before?

choices.label: I've heard about them, but never been this close.

Anemo_power__Just_from_praying.text:
Amber: Yep, just from praying! Watch. ''She steps up to the statue, sets her feet, and puts her palms together. For a moment, nothing seems to happen. Then a quiet gust of wind curls up from the ground around her feet, rises to her shoulders, and her scarf flutters even though the air around you is perfectly still.''

Amber: ''opens one eye and grins'' See? Barbatos says hi. ''She waves you toward the statue.'' Come on, let's try it together! I'll show you how.

choices.label: All right. I'll give it a shot

All_right_I_will_give_it_a_shot.text:
''You step up beside Amber in front of the statue. The ancient stone face gazes down in patient silence. Amber clasps her hands together dramatically close to her nose, eyes squeezed shut, clearly giving this her absolute full effort. You do the same.''

''Several seconds pass. The wind stirs around Amber again. She opens one eye and peeks at you hopefully.''

Amber: ''whispering'' It should be tingling by now. Is it tingling?

choices.label: Nothing. I don't feel anything at all

feelnothing.text:
''The statue remains completely cold and still on your side. No wind, no glow, no tingle of any kind. Amber stares at it, then at you, then at it again. She walks slowly around the base, examining it from every angle.''

Amber: Hmm. ''She knocks on the stone twice with her knuckle.'' That's odd. It works fine for me. Did you do it wrong somehow?

choices.label: I don't think prayer has a wrong technique
I have no idea. It just did nothing

I_dont_think_prayer_has_a_wrong_techniqu.text:
Amber: ''taps her chin'' You're right, you just... hm. ''She squints at you, then at the statue, then back at you.'' Okay but it definitely should have worked. ''Her expression shifts through about four different stages of thinking.'' Wait.

''A pause. Then she snaps her fingers so loud it echoes off the cliffside.''

Amber: Oh. Oh no. I completely forgot to mention the most important part.

Theres_a_most_important_part.text:
Amber: The offering! ''She looks genuinely sheepish.'' If it's your first time praying at a Statue of Seven, you have to bring a gift. It's like introducing yourself to Barbatos properly. You can't just walk up to an Archon and demand a blessing without bringing something nice, right? That would be so rude.

''She holds up one finger.''

Amber: The wind here is especially fond of Calla Lilies. They grow near the water all around Windrise. Bring twenty of them and lay them at the base of the statue, then pray again. Trust me. It absolutely works.

20call.text:
Amber: Twenty Calla Lilies! ''She holds up both hands and wiggles all ten fingers, then does it again for good measure.'' I know that sounds like a lot, but you can find them growing everywhere near the streams and ponds around here. White flowers, pretty tall, hard to miss once you know what you're looking for.

''She tilts her head.''

Amber: Bring them back and try again. I'll even stick around to watch. Or I'll be on patrol. One of those.

I_will_go_find_them.text:
Amber: ''double thumbs up'' That's the spirit! ''She fires her zip line back up into the cliffside with a sharp click and grabs the handle.'' I've got to get back to my route, but the statue will be right here when you return. Barbatos is patient. Probably!

Amber: Good luck finding the lilies! And be careful near the water, there are slimes around. Actually, you probably know how to handle slimes. Probably!

''She rockets upward and disappears over the ridge, her scarf trailing behind her.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Calla Lily and return to the Statue of Seven at Windrise

continues.label: Do /rpg and click on Pray at the Statue

getlecalla.text:
''You return to the Statue of Seven. The afternoon light makes the worn stone almost gold, and the air at Windrise carries the faint scent of wildflowers. Amber is here, sitting on a low rock near the base with her legs swinging like she had nowhere else to be.''

Amber: ''jumps to her feet'' You're back! Did you find the lilies?

choices.label: Yes. I have twenty Calla Lilies

not_yet.text:
Amber: No rush! ''She drops back onto the rock.'' I'll be here. Patrol can wait a little. Probably.

Amber: Remember, white flowers near the water. They're pretty common once you start looking. You've got this!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Calla Lily and return to the Statue of Seven at Windrise

blessed.title: Blessed by the Archon
blessed.text:
Amber: ''eyes lighting up'' Yes! Okay okay. ''She steps back to give you the full stage, clearly very excited.''

''You kneel at the base of the statue and carefully arrange the twenty Calla Lilies in a gentle arc around the stone. The white petals settle perfectly, barely moving even in the open air, as if something unseen is holding them in place.''

Amber: ''whispering'' Now close your eyes. Introduce yourself. Tell Barbatos why the wind should know your name.

''You bow your head and pray. For a moment, silence. Then the hum begins, deep and resonant, rising from the stone itself. The Calla Lilies glow faintly. A wave of warm air rises from the statue's base and wraps around you, then sinks into your chest with a feeling that has nothing to do with temperature.''

''You feel lighter. The air seems to lean in, listening.''

Amber: ''barely whispering'' Oh wow.

''The glow fades slowly, but the warmth stays.''

Amber: ''breaking into the biggest grin'' YOU DID IT! Barbatos said yes! The wind is yours now! I knew it would work, I absolutely knew it!
